segments.title: Solutions Built for Every Industry
segments.subtitle: Every organization has a different challenge — Aegis adapts to exactly what you need.

tabs.label: Banking & Finance
tabs.painPoint: Standardizing recruitment exams, periodic professional certification, and AML compliance across tens of thousands of staff.
tabs.solution: Absolute multi-tenant data isolation per branch, tamper-proof SHA-256 audit logs, and legally valid PKI digital signatures.

tabs.label: Multi-branch Enterprises
tabs.painPoint: Internal training scattered across many locations, hard to measure consistently.
tabs.solution: Team leaders manage their own question banks with real-time progress reporting per unit.

tabs.label: Universities & Education
tabs.painPoint: Massive paper exam archives, difficult to personalize learning paths for every student.
tabs.solution: 1-click digitization from Word/MathType, AI adaptive testing personalized to real ability.

tabs.label: Driving Test Centers
tabs.painPoint: Need to simulate theory tests to the national transport authority's standard, including instant-fail critical questions.
tabs.solution: Automatic critical-question (fail-instantly) logic, plus AI-simulated road-scenario practice.
